title: Jonah and the Thorn
author: Jude Blackwood
blurb: Sable Coldharbour, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
